notes: Press interaction beat. Fires after a significant floor vote. Speaker: Jordan Cross (TV correspondent) — Media Operator archetype. Purpose: introduce the post-vote press dynamic; the player must manage a journalist who has a sourced count figure that may or may not match the official line. Two choice points: (1) how the player handles the opening question — direct answer / pivot / no comment / prepared deflection (flag-gated on media_training_complete); (2) how the player responds to the sourced gotcha — deny / partial acknowledgment / own the count with correction (Integrity ≥ 5 gate). Branch-specific flags (media-count-denied, media-count-partial, media-count-confirmed) are observable by future press events and reputation tracking. No faction effects authored. 'jordan-cross' is a new character not in GDD §12.3.4 named seed list — TODO(vex): Jesse to create wiki entry. 'press-interactions' arcId is a placeholder — TODO(vex): confirm arc namespace for press beats with Sol (OQ-W3-A). 'media_training_complete' flag prerequisite implies an offscreen media training event not yet authored — TODO(vex): author media-training beat or confirm flag source. Integrity ≥ 5 gate on opt-own-it is authoring intent; confirm threshold with balance pass (OQ-W3-B). See intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md Content wave 3 for all open questions.

open.speaker: narrator
open.text: A half-dozen cameras swing toward you as you clear the chamber door. Jordan Cross is already at the front.

first-question.speaker: jordan-cross
first-question.text: Senator — the vote was closer than your office projected. What does that tell you about your coalition?

options.label: The coalition held where it needed to.
What matters now is what comes next, not the margin.
I'm not taking questions right now.
We ran this scenario three weeks ago. Today was plan A.
options.failureHint: You haven't done the media prep to deliver this cleanly.

response-direct.speaker: jordan-cross
response-direct.text: Held where it needed to — that's twelve votes short of comfortable. You're reading from a different script.

response-pivot.speaker: jordan-cross
response-pivot.text: Next is a conference committee your bloc doesn't control. Is 'what comes next' a strategy or a hope?

response-stonewalled.speaker: jordan-cross
response-stonewalled.text: Three of your colleagues made statements at that door today. You don't have one?

response-controlled.speaker: jordan-cross
response-controlled.text: Three weeks is longer than our pre-vote story projected. Who told you to expect this result?

gotcha-setup.speaker: jordan-cross
gotcha-setup.text: Before you walk — our assignment desk picked something up this morning.

gotcha.speaker: jordan-cross
gotcha.text: We're hearing from two sources the whip's office ran a count that had you down by six this morning. Is that accurate?

options.label: That number isn't one I recognize.
We knew the count was tight. That's why we worked the weekend.
We were down by five, not six. The last vote moved Thursday night.
options.failureHint: Requires Integrity 5. Correcting the record on the record takes a clean history.

exit-hostile.speaker: jordan-cross
exit-hostile.text: The whip's office is fifty feet away. We'll have their comment before the segment closes.

exit-mixed.speaker: jordan-cross
exit-mixed.text: Working the weekend. Is that the strategy going into conference committee?

exit-clean.speaker: jordan-cross
exit-clean.text: That's on the record. I'm going to need to verify — but that's on the record.

exit.speaker: narrator
exit.text: You're moving before she can follow up. The scrum collapses behind you into cables and argument.
